name: Diplomat’s Signet
body:
Price 1,600 gp; Slot ring; CL 3rd; Weight —; Aura faint divination

DESCRIPTION

Plated with gold, this ring bears the relief of a sword’s hilt that has a feather coming out of it. This ring grants its wearer a +2 insight bonus to Knowledge (nobility) and Diplomacy. This bonus stacks with the bonuses gained from diplomat’s brooch and diplomat’s pocket watch.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 800 gp; Feats Forge Ring, augury
